prompt: Write a detailed story based on this idea: in a small Midwestern farming town a few rich families keep thousands of cattle in barns all winter and then let pigs loose on the thick layer of manure instead of buying grain. The main character is a young farmhand who discovers this cost-cutting scheme and struggles with loyalty to his boss, his own moral code, and the need to support his family. Set the narrative over a full year with vivid descriptions of the seasons, the smells and sounds of the barns, and the daily grind of farm life. Make sure to explore themes of greed, community pressure, and personal growth and aim for roughly 8,000 to 10,000 words.
